conflicts.claim_as_written: On your compression ask: we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch — Gustavo owns the recipe build within his 50%, with Efe supporting — to distill the expensive post-editing teacher setup into a student model we can run continuously. I checked around and nothing in-house covers this, so we're budgeting it as a ground-up build: roughly six engineer-weeks, first trainable version mid-June.
